name: The NEW Teen Titans
title: The New Teen Titans #1
desc: The New Teen Titans have been formed, but who is the mysterious orange girl and who are the green aliens after her? This is a new beginning for the Teen Titans, but with a few new faces. Raven, the mystical girl who can vanish and conjure darkness has assembled a new team for unknown reasons. The new team consists of old faces Kid Flash, Robin, Wonder Girl and Beast Boy (er, Changeling), and new faces Cyborg, Starfire and Raven. Starfire is a refugee from a distant planet who can absorb languages through touch. The first human she touches is Dick Grason and with a kiss, she learns English.
